From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, June 20, 2018 10:10 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Night/day games 
 
Found it. Thanks for doing that.
On Jun 20, 2018, at 8:43 AM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
I sent in a mailbag for the morning.

Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Wednesday, June 20, 2018 9:30:21 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Night/day games 
 
Anthony: Is there anything coming from last night? If not, my suggestion is tweaking our approach on night games followed by noon starts. I get there’s limited shelf life, but it’s also our best window of the day to drive traffic. I think we’re missing an opportunity
Whether or not you write at night, the expectation is to have something of substance on the site by 8 a.m. That gives us 4 good hours of content on noon starts.
